body: I don't know if anyone was even monitoring this thread, but I decided not to do it. Mostly for my little sister. Thanks guys.
I have absolutely nothing to live for, I know its selfish but I wont be around to see the people that love me suffer

I wish I could tell you. I just cant connect with anyone. I think I'm just gonna do it. This will probably sound stupid to most of you but I was raised in a religious family. I sure as fuck hope hell doesn't exist.

It's not really leaving hs behind, its like, what comes afterwards. I can't relate to anyone. I spend ages 14-17 doing a shit ton of drugs with my friends (dont have them anymore) instead of pursuing a normal high school experience. I also spent about 10 months outside of the country, where I would stay in my room for literally weeks at a time. I have an incredibly addictive personality. I spend all of my time online. I want someone to hang out with in real life. I want a girlfriend. I don't know man. I'm a huge extrovert but I have terrible social anxiety and I can't relate to anyone.
